summary: An articulated (bendy) city bus about 18.6 m long: the library bus as the front section, a pleated concertina… joints door_front, door_front_fold, door_rear, door_rear_fold, articulation, door_trailer, …; options type; sockets eye_point, socket_driver, socket_front_door, socket_rear_door, socket_trailer_door.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.bus_articulated or place "prefab": "bus_articulated" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
